user.title: LifeSmart Hub
user.description: Set up your LifeSmart Hub integration

data_description.host: The hub's address on your network: an IP address or a hostname.
data_description.model: The OpenDev model string shown with your token in the LifeSmart app, for example OD_XXX_XXX. This is not the model printed on the hub. The hubs tested so far do not check it; only the token has to be right.
data_description.token: The OpenDev token from the LifeSmart app. 16 to 64 letters and digits.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure LifeSmart Hub
reconfigure.description: Update your LifeSmart Hub connection settings

data_description.host: The hub's address on your network: an IP address or a hostname.
data_description.model: The OpenDev model string shown with your token in the LifeSmart app, for example OD_XXX_XXX. This is not the model printed on the hub. The hubs tested so far do not check it; only the token has to be right.
data_description.token: The OpenDev token from the LifeSmart app. 16 to 64 letters and digits.

reauth_confirm.title: LifeSmart Hub: new token needed
reauth_confirm.description: The hub at {host} rejected the stored token. Enter the current OpenDev token from the LifeSmart app. The address and the model stay as they are.

data_description.token: The OpenDev token from the LifeSmart app. 16 to 64 letters and digits.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the hub
error.invalid_auth: The hub rejected this token (code 101, although the time was correct). Check the OpenDev token in the LifeSmart app.
error.clock_skew: The hub rejected the request (code 101) and did not report its time, so the clock could not be corrected. Check the token, and sync the Home Assistant host's clock with NTP.
error.no_devices: No devices found on the hub
error.unexpected_reply: The hub answered, but not with a device list. The reply is in the Home Assistant log.

hub_unreachable.title: LifeSmart hub is unreachable
hub_unreachable.description: The hub at {host} has not answered for {minutes} minutes. Check that the hub is powered on, the IP is correct, and Home Assistant shares the same LAN segment. This notice clears itself once the hub answers again.

send_keys.name: Send IR keys
send_keys.description: Send IR key(s) to a remote. With several hubs, the key goes to the hub that has the remote.

config_entry_id.name: Hub
config_entry_id.description: Optional. Send through this hub only.

remote_id.name: Remote ID
remote_id.description: Remote ID returned by the hub.

keys.name: Keys
keys.description: One key or a list of keys to send.

set_hub_timezone.name: Set hub time zone
set_hub_timezone.description: Set the hub's time zone and daylight saving time (cfg:timezone).

timezone.name: Time zone
timezone.description: UTC offset in whole hours, -12 to 12. East is positive.

daylight_saving.name: Daylight saving time
daylight_saving.description: Whether the hub applies daylight saving time.

rename_device.name: Rename device on the hub
rename_device.description: Set the name the hub stores for itself or one of its devices (cfg:devname). The integration reloads afterwards.

config_entry_id.name: Hub
config_entry_id.description: The LifeSmart hub the device belongs to.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Leave empty, or pick the hub, to rename the hub itself.

upgrade_hub_firmware.name: Upgrade hub firmware
upgrade_hub_firmware.description: Download the latest official firmware from LifeSmart's server to the hub (cfg:upgrade). It takes effect after the hub restarts.

reboot.name: Restart when downloaded
reboot.description: Restart the hub as soon as the download finishes.

factory_reset_hub.name: Factory reset hub
factory_reset_hub.description: Restore the hub's factory settings and restart it (cfg:reset). This cannot be undone.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be on, or the action is refused.
